title: 2015 HMMT February Combinatorics Problem 1
statement: Evan's analog clock displays the time \(12: 13\); the number of seconds is not shown. After 10 seconds elapse, it is still 12:13. What is the expected number of seconds until 12:14?

solutions.text: 25 At first, the time is uniformly distributed between 12:13:00 and 12:13:50. After 10 seconds, the time is uniformly distributed between \(12: 13: 10\) and \(12: 14: 00\). Thus, it takes on average 25 seconds to reach 12:14(:00).
